data: Just a few line to ask yall if yall could send me some Coupons so I could save some money on my next Carton of Doral that I buy.
See I'm on a small monthly check. And I could use them.
Yall sent some to a friend of mine. And he told me about the deal yall have got going the Doral. You save 70 pack seals and get a Carton free.
Send me a couple of envelopes where I can use them.
Well I be waiting to hear from you.
